uncertain.Net-(D1-K): common-source midpoint of back-to-back PFET pair Q1; carries VBUS load current but is an internal switch node (also gate-zener reference)
uncertain.Net-(Q3A-D1): midpoint of back-to-back PFET pair Q3 on the safe-5V path; carries current, not a usable rail
uncertain.Net-(Q2-G): CYPD3177 FAULT output driving LED transistor; could be read as power-good/fault (power_control)
uncertain.Net-(U1-ISNK_COARSE): resistor-divider config input setting requested sink current; config strap vs power_control
uncertain.Net-(U1-ISNK_FINE): resistor-divider config input setting requested sink current; config strap vs power_control
uncertain.Net-(U1-VBUS_MAX): resistor-divider config input setting max requested VBUS; config strap vs power_control
uncertain.Net-(U1-VBUS_MIN): resistor-divider config input setting min requested VBUS; config strap vs power_control
uncertain.Net-(U1-VCCD): CYPD3177 internal 1.8V core LDO output, decoupling cap only
uncertain.VCC_USB_SAFE_5V: switched safe-5V output that only feeds indicator LED D3
uncertain.J2: output terminal block: PD power leaves the board here (signal_connector per rules)
